title: digest_changelog
description: Digest projection of a changelog markdown file (CHANGELOG.md or changelog/*.md). Extracts structured version and change-category facts for D11/D12 checks. No prose summarisation — structured lists only.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a changelog digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. CHANGELOG.md or changelog/v0.3.0.md).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

version_label.description: Version label for the primary version section in this file (e.g. Unreleased, 0.3.0). Derived from the top-level ## heading.

release_date.description: Release date string if present in the version heading (e.g. 2026-02-26). Empty string if not present (unreleased).

is_unreleased.description: True if this file or section describes unreleased changes (version_label is Unreleased or file is unreleased.md).

breaking.description: Change-line strings under a Breaking or Required section header.

added.description: Change-line strings under an Added section header.

changed.description: Change-line strings under a Changed section header.

removed.description: Change-line strings under a Removed section header.

deprecated.description: Change-line strings under a Deprecated section header.

fixed.description: Change-line strings under a Fixed section header.

section_headers.description: All H3-level (###) section header texts found inside the version block, in document order.

total_entries.description: Total count of change-line entries across all sections.

has_breaking_changes.description: True if the breaking[] array is non-empty.
